title: 第005章 黑铁级 深渊宝箱第006章 唯一奇观 混沌泉眼
slug: 领主神级词条招募原罪堕天使
lines: 苏业看着系统面板，除了交易模块是灰色的，无法打开之外，其它的模块都可以正常的使用。
至于交易模块无法使用，是为了维护新手领主之间，那仅存的一点公平，这点公平是指所有新手领主的起跑线都是一样的，全靠运气。
如果没有这个限制的话，那些二代领主早就起飞了，谁玩的过他们啊。
这些二代领主之中，其中不乏一些家族之中有真神的存在，真可以交易，那其他新手领主真不用玩了。
苏业直接打开了聊天频道看了起来。
大部分都在讨论自己的兵种或者天赋的。
【哈哈哈，老子要起飞了，七阶兵种双足飞龙，还有谁？】
【起飞，起飞个锤子哦，你怕是不知道双足飞龙每天要消耗多少单位的食物，你养的起吗？】
【新手期还好，每天的试炼只要胆子大点问题不大，过了新手期，五阶以上的兵种都是吞金大户。】
【酸，我看你们就是酸人家随机到了好的兵营，大佬带带带。】
【大佬我可以帮你养殖，求带。】
【焯，凭什么老子的兵营就是农田，只能招募农民，比我还弱，这玩个锤子，点了。】
苏业饶有兴趣的看着聊天频道，现在大部分新手领主都还在调整自己的状态，都没有选择开启虚空试炼。
毕竟这玩意可不是说说的，虽然是新手期，但是翻车的可能也不小。
看了一会之后。
苏业直接关闭了聊天频道，随后打开了直播模块。
新手领主三十天内是无法离开永恒世界的，只有等新手时期结束，或者说被淘汰，才能离开永恒世界。
其目的还是只有一个，防止作弊。
直播模块的作用一个是娱乐，另外一个则是教学。
都是收费的，当然不可能免费给你看。
苏业直接点进热度最高的新手领主直播间。
一点进去就直接愣住了。
“卧槽！！”苏业看着面前的直播。
emmmm，怎么说呢，直播间是一个新手女领主，是汉斯猫国的人，她的兵种是哥布林，直播当然也是颜色直播。
懂不懂哥布林的含金量啊。（改）
“不愧是汉斯猫家的，这方面还是遥遥领先啊。”苏业看着直播间的画面不由的想到，论胃口，还是汉斯猫更为重一些。
一群绿皮围攻金毛。（改）
“有一说一，身材还真不错。”苏业话刚说完，直播间直接黑了，想要继续看下去，就需要付费了，一个小时一金币，赚血汗钱。（改）
苏业看了看其他直播间，现在搞直播的基本上都是开眼直播。
什么兵种都有，哥布林，牛头人，猪头人，巨魔，甚至还有触手怪。
当然也有一部分直播砍树的和挖矿的。
看了一会，苏业直接关掉了直播面板。
现在他还没有多余的钱，去搞娱乐，别人的1金币或许也就几阶的兵种，自己的1金币那就是一个神级兵种单位，运气好还是神级英雄单位。
这种事情还是等以后有多余的金币再说。
苏业看向莉莉丝等人的战况。
随着时间的流逝，苏业领地边缘，一头头小恶魔冲了进来，地上一个个宝箱浮现在了地上。
这就是新手期的福利，只要你实力够，就能不断的积累资源，苏业粗略的算了一下，大概有数十个宝箱。
content_en:
Su ye looked at the system panel. Except for the transaction module, which was gray and could not be opened, all other modules could be used normally.
As for the unavailability of the transaction module, it is to maintain the only remaining fairness among novice lords. This fairness means that all novice lords have the same starting line and it all depends on luck.
If there was no such restriction, those second-generation lords would have taken off long ago. Who could outplay them?
Among these second-generation lords, there are many families with true gods who can really be traded, so other novice lords really don’t have to play.
Su ye directly opened the chat channel and started watching.
Most of them are discussing their own arms or talents.
[Hahaha, I’m about to take off, the seventh-level flying dragon, who else? 】
[Take off, take off with a hammer. I’m afraid you don’t know how many units of food the bipedal dragon consumes every day. Can you afford it? 】
[The novice stage is okay. The daily trials are not a big problem as long as you are braver. After the novice stage, all the troops above level five are big gold eaters. 】
[Sour, I think you are just sour. You randomly arrived at a good military camp, and the boss took care of you. 】
[Boss, I can help you breed. Please bring me. 】
[Zhuo, why is it that my barracks are farmland and I can only recruit farmers, who are weaker than me? This is a hammer, click. 】
............
Su Ye watched the chat channel with interest. Most of the novice lords are still adjusting their status and have not chosen to start the Void Trial.
After all, this thing is not just for words. Although it is a novice stage, the possibility of overturning is not small.
After watching for a while.
Su ye directly closed the chat channel, and then opened the live broadcast module.
Novice lords cannot leave the eternal world within thirty days. They can only leave the eternal world after the novice period ends, or is eliminated.
Its purpose is still to prevent cheating.
The function of the live broadcast module is entertainment and teaching.
There is a fee, so of course it is impossible to give it to you for free.
Su ye directly clicked into the most popular novice lord live broadcast room.
As soon as I entered, I was stunned.
"Fuck!!" Su ye looked at the live broadcast in front of him.
Emmmm, how should I put it, the live broadcast room is a novice female lord, she is from Hans Cat Kingdom, her unit is Goblin, the live broadcast is of course also a color live broadcast.
Do you understand the value of goblins? (change)
"As expected of the Hans Cat family, they are still far ahead in this regard." Su Ye looked at the live broadcast room and couldn't help but think that in terms of appetite, Hans Cat has a heavier appetite.
A group of greenskins besieged the golden retriever. (change)
"Let me tell you, you have a really good figure." As soon as Su Ye finished speaking, the live broadcast room went dark. If you want to continue watching, you need to pay, one gold coin per hour, and earn your hard-earned money. (change)
Su Ye looked at other live broadcast rooms and found that those currently doing live broadcasts were basically eye-opening live broadcasts.
There are all kinds of soldiers, goblins, tauren, pigs, trolls, and even tentacle monsters.
Of course, there are also some who live broadcast cutting trees and mining.
After watching it for a while, Su ye turned off the live broadcast panel directly.
Now he doesn't have extra money to engage in entertainment. Others' 1 gold coin may only be a few levels of troops, while his own 1 gold coin is a god-level unit. If he is lucky, it will be a god-level hero unit.
Let’s wait until we have extra gold coins to talk about this kind of thing later.
Su ye looked at the fighting situation of Lilith and others.
As time passed, little demons rushed in from the edge of Su ye's territory, and treasure boxes appeared on the ground.
This is the benefit of the novice stage. As long as you are strong enough, you can continue to accumulate resources. Su ye did a rough calculation and found that there were probably dozens of treasure boxes.
